scope.rationale: D-01 is evidence-only: the new preparation probe test is the only compiled input. The affected subset is the probe class plus the legacy Pivot/Unpivot/eager-guard inventory used as a pre-change baseline; the SQL Server test project is the only project touched.
scope.boundary: Single post-implementation boundary planned for D-07: full per-project test sweeps plus the six-provider container integration run (C07/C08/C11); not executed by D-01.

coverage_note: C06 (legacy inventory) is recorded as provenance + legacy-inventory.json, not as a report execution: the C06 filter carries a '|' token that scripts/validate_inner_loop.py rejects in an execution (rule 7). C10 coverage baseline and C15 acceptance baseline are recorded through their own JSON files and provenance records.
